_comment: Add your own API endpoints WITHOUT touching LiveCode. Drop this file (named .qsroutes.json) in the folder you share; No Cloud Quick Share reads it and serves the routes below. Each route returns a canned body or a redirect - no code runs, paths under /_qs/ and /_edit/ are reserved, and this dotfile itself is never served. Requires the engine's JSON support (fails closed if absent).

routes.body: This endpoint was declared in .qsroutes.json - no LiveCode, no cloud.
